issue_body: The setup instructions mention a wrong command for installing dependencies. This confuses new users trying to run the project. Update the command to the correct one.

issue_title: Add missing null check in CSV loader
issue_body: The CSV loader crashes when encountering empty rows. A simple null check should prevent this issue. Add validation before processing rows.
The help output is hard to read because of poor spacing. Adjust formatting to make it more user friendly. Align command descriptions.
The import statement uses a deprecated sklearn module. Update it to the latest recommended version. This will prevent warnings during execution.

issue_title: Add error handling for missing config file
issue_body: The app crashes if config.json is missing. Add a fallback or clear error message. This will improve usability.
The API endpoint in the code is outdated. Replace it with the correct version. This currently causes failed requests.
There are no sample tests for new contributors. Add a simple test file to demonstrate usage. This helps beginners understand testing setup.

issue_title: Fix script path issue on Windows
issue_body: The script fails on Windows due to incorrect path separators. Update code to handle cross platform paths. This will improve compatibility.
Database inserts are not persisted due to missing commit. Add commit statement after insert operation. This fixes data loss issue.
README lacks usage examples for commands. Add simple examples to guide new users. This improves onboarding.
The footer contains a broken link to documentation. Update it to the correct URL. This improves navigation.
A loop can be replaced with pandas vectorized operation. This will improve performance. Update implementation accordingly.
The code does not handle timeout errors. Add try except block for requests timeout. This prevents crashes.
The training script lacks comments. Add explanations for each step. This helps beginners understand ML flow.

issue_title: Fix assertion error in sample test
issue_body: The sample test fails due to incorrect expected value. Update expected output. This ensures tests pass correctly.
The backup script does not log actions. Add basic logging statements. This helps debugging.
There is a typo in the SELECT query. Correct the column name. This currently causes query failure.
The CLI argument crashes when not provided. Add a default value. This improves usability.
The error page is plain and unclear. Improve layout and message clarity. This enhances user experience.
The function lacks proper documentation. Add a clear docstring. This helps maintainability.
The response parsing fails for invalid JSON. Add validation before parsing. This prevents runtime errors.
The project does not include dependency list. Add requirements.txt with needed libraries. This helps setup.
The pytest version is outdated. Update it to latest stable version. This avoids compatibility issues.
The cron example is incorrect. Update it to valid syntax. This ensures proper scheduling.

issue_title: Add index to improve query speed

Some commands are not registered properly. Update command registration logic. This resolves missing commands.
The app does not include a favicon. Add a default favicon. This improves appearance.
The function fails on empty dataframe. Add condition to handle this case. This avoids crashes.

issue_title: Add retry logic for failed requests
issue_body: The API calls fail without retry. Implement simple retry mechanism. This improves reliability.
Labels are encoded incorrectly in training. Update encoding logic. This improves model accuracy.
Test coverage is not measured. Add configuration for coverage tool. This improves testing insights.
Script fails due to permission errors. Update file handling logic. This ensures proper execution.
Database connection hangs indefinitely. Add timeout setting. This improves stability.
Error messages are vague. Update them to be more descriptive. This helps debugging.
Template fails to render correctly. Debug variable passing. This resolves display issue.
Currently only CSV is supported. Add Excel file support. This increases usability.
Headers are not sent correctly. Fix authentication header logic. This allows API access.
No dataset link is provided. Add link in README. This helps users start quickly.

Script lacks clear instructions. Add usage guide. This helps new users.

issue_title: Fix typo in README installation steps
issue_body: The current README says npm isntall instead of npm install. This might confuse new users trying to set up the project. Please update the documentation section.

issue_title: Add missing validation for user email
issue_body: The registration endpoint does not check if the email string contains an @ symbol. We should add a simple regex check in the controller. This is a good entry-level task for backend practice.
The CLI output for the --help flag is missing the new version command. We need to append the version flag description to the console log. It should be a single line change in commands.ts.

The toggle button for Celsius and Fahrenheit is currently gray and hard to see. It should be changed to a primary blue color for better visibility. Please update the CSS file in the components folder.
The server port is currently hardcoded as 3000 in index.js. We should update it to use process.env.PORT with a fallback value. This helps with deploying to platforms like Heroku.

issue_title: Add welcome message for new members
issue_body: The bot should send a simple greeting when someone joins the server. Use the guildMemberAdd event to trigger a message in the general channel. This is perfect for learning event listeners.
If a product image fails to load it shows a broken icon. We need to add an onError handler to the img tag to show a placeholder image instead. Look into the ProductCard.vue component.

issue_title: Add basic unit test for math utils
issue_body: We are missing tests for the subtract and multiply functions in utils.js. Create a new test file and add simple assertions using Jest expect. This will help improve our code coverage.
The Twitter icon in the footer points to a 404 page. Please update the href attribute in Footer.tsx to the correct project handle. It is a very quick fix.

issue_title: Center login button on small screens
issue_body: The login button is shifted to the left on smaller device screens. We need to adjust the flexbox alignment in the styles object to center it properly. Test it on an emulated mobile device.
When the API returns a 404 the console is currently silent. We should add a console.error statement inside the catch block to help developers debug. Only log the status code and message.

issue_title: Add hover effect to project cards
issue_body: The project cards look static when the mouse moves over them. Adding a simple CSS scale transition or shadow would make the UI feel more interactive. Edit the styles.css file.
We need a simple utility function that returns true if a number is even. The function should take a number as input and return a boolean. Make sure to export it from the main index.ts file.
The current logger only prints the method and URL. It would be helpful to include the current date and time in ISO format for each request. Modify the logger middleware function.
The modal overlay is currently appearing behind the navigation bar on some pages. Increasing the z-index in the CSS module should resolve this layout issue. Verify the fix on the demo page.
Some API responses return null for ingredient fields which causes the app to crash. Add a simple check to filter these out before mapping over the list. This is located in the RecipeDetail component.
The app currently deletes tasks immediately without asking. We should add a simple y/n prompt using the readline module to prevent accidental deletions. Look at the delete command logic.
The CONTRIBUTING.md file is outdated and mentions an old build command. Please update it to reflect the move from npm to pnpm. This is important for new contributors.
The hamburger menu does not close when a link is clicked. We need to add an onClick handler to the menu links that sets the isOpen state to false. This affects the mobile view only.
The success message for the daily backup job says "Back up completed" instead of "Backup completed". Search for the string in the cron job controller. It is a one-word change.
The state management logic in AppContext.js is a bit hard to follow for beginners. Please add inline comments explaining the useReducer setup and the provider value. This will help with onboarding.
The search endpoint currently returns all matching records which could be hundreds. We should add a default limit of 20 results per query. Update the query builder logic in the service layer.
Users have requested a Ctrl+S or Cmd+S shortcut to save files. We need to register this accelerator in the main process menu template. Check the electron documentation for accelerators.
We are getting a React warning about passing non-standard attributes to the DOM. Use the $ prefix for transient props in the StyledButton component. This is a common pattern in styled-components.
The User type in the schema is missing the 'bio' field which is already present in the database. Update the .graphql schema file to include this optional string field. Then regenerate the types.
The default movement speed feels a bit sluggish during testing. We should increase the SPEED constant from 5 to 8 in the Player.js file. This will make the gameplay feel more responsive.

issue_title: Add required validation to Name field
issue_body: The name input in the contact form currently allows empty submissions. We need to add the required: true validation rule to the register function call. Also show a small red error message.
We need a basic healthcheck instruction in our Dockerfile to monitor the container status. It can be a simple curl command to the /ping endpoint. This improves our deployment reliability.
The calculator crashes when a user tries to divide by zero. We should add an if statement to check the divisor and display "Error" instead of Infinity. Update the calculate function.
The splash screen color in manifest.json does not match our new branding. Please change the background_color hex code to #3f51b5. This ensures a consistent look on mobile devices.
The variables 'a' and 'b' in the middleware are confusing. They should be renamed to 'requestStartTime' and 'requestEndTime' to be more descriptive. This is purely a code cleanup task.
We currently only support Celsius and Fahrenheit. Let's expand the utility to include distance conversion between miles and km. Add a new function in converter.ts with the correct formula.
The table headers look cramped because the text is touching the borders. Adding 10px of horizontal padding to the th elements in the CSS file will fix this. It will improve overall readability.
The helper throws an error saying "Unauthorizied" when a token is missing. It should be spelled "Unauthorized". Look for this string in the auth-helper.js file.
We are logging when users join but not when they leave the chat. Add a console log inside the 'disconnect' socket event listener. This helps monitor active connections.
We need to ensure that the addProduct function correctly increments the total count. Create a simple test case using Vitest to verify this behavior. Check the existing tests for examples.
The logout route currently redirects to /home but it should go to /login. This is causing confusion for users who think they are still logged in. Update the res.redirect call.
The icon set is missing a visual for the drizzle weather state. We need to import the SVG file and add it to the icon mapping object in WeatherIcon.tsx. The SVG is already in the assets folder.
Our custom fetch wrapper should support a timeout to prevent hanging requests. Use the AbortController API to implement a 10-second default timeout. This is a great introduction to modern JS APIs.
The brand logo in the navbar is currently just text. It should be wrapped in a Link component that points back to the homepage. This improves site navigation for users.
Users want a way to delete all finished tasks at once. Add a button at the bottom of the list that filters the state to remove items where completed is true. Update the UI and the handler.
The logs are currently saved as .txt but should be .log for better compatibility with log viewers. Update the file naming logic in the winston configuration. It is a minor configuration change.

issue_title: Update chart colors to accessible palette
issue_body: The current green and red colors are not colorblind-friendly. We should switch to a more accessible palette like blue and orange. Update the color constants in the Theme.js file.

issue_title: Add min length check for passwords
issue_body: The validator allows 1-character passwords which is a security risk. We should enforce a minimum length of 8 characters in the password validation function. Return a descriptive error message if it fails.
The parser currently fails to render bold text if there are no spaces around the double asterisks. We need to adjust the regular expression in the parser.js file to be more flexible.
The search bar is currently empty and might be confusing. Please add a default placeholder like "Search for articles..." to the input element. This is a very simple JSX change.

New developers are struggling to write their first GraphQL query. We should add a section to the README with a few copy-pasteable examples for fetching users and posts. This will help with onboarding.

The server crashes when a file larger than 5MB is uploaded. We need to catch the 'limit exceeded' error from the middleware and return a 413 status code instead of crashing. Test with a large dummy file.

The icons in the sidebar are not perfectly centered relative to the text labels. Adjust the CSS grid or flexbox settings in Sidebar.module.css to fix the vertical alignment. It looks off by a few pixels.
We often need to capitalize just the first letter of a string for UI headings. Add a small utility function to strings.js that does this efficiently. Include a few basic unit tests.
The app currently serves files from /assets but the standard is usually /public. Rename the directory and update the express.static middleware configuration. Check for any broken image links after.

The modal component is not cleaning up its event listener for the 'Escape' key. Add a return function to the useEffect hook to remove the event listener when the component unmounts. This prevents potential leaks.

issue_title: Fix broken link in Swagger UI
issue_body: The link to the 'User' model in the documentation is broken. It seems the reference path in the swagger.yaml file is incorrect. Please update it to point to the right definition. This affects the API playground.
We need a utility to randomly reorder elements in an array. Use the Fisher-Yates shuffle algorithm for better randomness. Add the function to arrays.js and export it.

The Content Security Policy is currently too restrictive and blocking our CDN images. We need to add 'https://www.google.com/search?q=cdn.example.com' to the img-src directive in the helmet config. This will fix the broken images on production.
The tasks are currently displayed in the order they were added. We should sort them so the most recent tasks appear at the top. Update the sorting logic in the TaskList component.
The global error boundary shows a generic message for everything. We should check the error status and show a specific "Page Not Found" message for 404 errors. This makes the app feel more polished.

Two quick saves can sometimes overwrite each other because the file write isn't awaited properly. Ensure that the writeFileSync or await writeFile is correctly implemented in the save method. This is a critical but small fix.
The email input only checks if the field is empty. Add a simple regex check to ensure the input follows a valid email format. This will reduce invalid data in our database.
The terminal output is currently all white. Use the 'chalk' library to make the temperature red if it's hot and blue if it's cold. This makes the CLI tool much more readable.
The calendar grid is shifted by one day when the week is set to start on Monday. We need to adjust the calculation for the empty padding cells in the first row. Look at the CalendarGrid.tsx file.

issue_title: Check for at least one number
issue_body: Passwords should be required to have at least one numeric digit. Update the validation logic to include this check and add a corresponding error message. This is part of our security hardening.

The current limit of 5 attempts per hour is too low for our testing environment. Increase it to 20 attempts in the development configuration file. This will prevent developers from getting locked out.

issue_title: Add category field to Post model
issue_body: Users want to categorize their blog posts. We need to add a 'category' string field to the Post schema and update the creation endpoint to accept this new property. Don't forget to update the types.

issue_title: Add retry logic for failed emails
issue_body: Sometimes the SMTP server is busy and the email fails on the first try. We should implement a simple retry mechanism that attempts to send the email up to 3 times before giving up. Use a small delay between tries.
Our store.ts file is getting too large because all slices are defined in one place. Move the counter and user slices into their own files within a 'features' folder. This improves project structure.

issue_title: Add test for division by zero
issue_body: We have a bug report for division by zero but no regression test. Add a new test case in math.test.js that asserts the function returns null when dividing by zero. This will prevent the bug from returning.
The page layout shifts when images finally load. We should use a gray div as a placeholder with the same dimensions as the image to reserve the space. Update the ImageComponent.tsx file.

Trying to register with an existing email throws a server error instead of a 400 Bad Request. Catch the database unique constraint violation and return a clean error message. This is located in the user controller.

The help menu is currently misaligned because of tab vs space usage. Reformat the string to use consistent spacing so the commands and descriptions line up perfectly. It should look neat in the terminal.
Our formatter currently only supports 'YYYY-MM-DD'. We need to add a new option to support the European date format. Update the switch statement in the format function.
The API client is expecting an array but the server now returns an object with a 'data' property. Update the interface definition to match the new JSON structure. This will fix the build errors.

issue_title: Fix bug in Bubble Sort logic
issue_body: The bubble sort animation skips the last element in the array during the first pass. This results in an unsorted list. Check the loop boundaries in the bubbleSort.ts file.
The /health endpoint only checks if the server is up. It should also attempt a simple DB query to ensure the connection is active. Return a 'db: healthy' status in the JSON response.
The library system is calculating the due date as 13 days instead of 14. This is likely a 'less than' vs 'less than or equal to' error in the date helper. Please verify and fix the logic.

We are currently using localStorage for the dark mode setting but it's not available server-side. Switching to a cookie will prevent the "flash" of white light on page load. Update the toggle function.
Our custom event emitter is missing a way to trigger a listener only once. Implement the 'once' method which removes the listener immediately after it is called. This is a classic coding challenge.
The authentication system is missing a logout endpoint. It should clear the session cookie and redirect the user to the login page. This is a straightforward task in the auth controller.
The 'Previous' button is still clickable when the user is on the first page. We need to set the disabled attribute to true when the currentPage is 1. This will prevent unnecessary API calls.
Our CLI logger only supports colors but not text styles. Add a flag or a new method to enable bold formatting using ANSI escape codes. This will help highlight important headers in the output.
Quickly double-clicking a todo item creates two identical edit inputs. We should add a check to see if the item is already in 'edit mode' before triggering the state change. This is in TodoItem.tsx.
The video player only has a mute toggle but no way to adjust the volume. Add a range input that controls the volume property of the video element. Ensure it stays between 0 and 1.

issue_title: Allow requests from local dev port
issue_body: The API is blocking requests from localhost:5173 which is the default for Vite. We need to update the CORS origin list to include this address so frontend devs can work locally.
Searching for 'apple' does not find 'Apple'. We should convert both the search query and the item text to lowercase before comparing them. This will make the search much more user-friendly.

The calculator crashes if a user types a letter instead of a number. Add a check using isNaN() to validate inputs and print a friendly "Please enter a valid number" message. This is in the input handler.

Users without an uploaded photo see a broken image icon. We should set a default 'placeholder.png' in the src attribute if the user's avatar URL is null or undefined. Check the ProfileHeader component.

The useQuery hook is currently returning 'any' for the data object. We need to pass the correct Generic type to the hook so we get full autocomplete in our components. This will improve developer experience.
The border under the active tab is gray instead of the brand's primary purple. Update the CSS class in the Tabs.css file to use the correct hex code. It's a small visual fix for brand consistency.

issue_title: Add validation for user input in create handler
issue_body: Currently the create endpoint accepts empty strings for username and email. We should add basic validation to ensure these fields are not empty and that email contains an @ symbol.

issue_title: Improve error message when config file is missing
issue_body: The tool panics if the config file doesn't exist. We should display a user-friendly error message suggesting to run init command first.
The endpoint returns all users at once which could cause performance issues. Implement pagination with default page size 20.

issue_title: Fix broken link in navigation partial
issue_body: The "About" link points to /about but the route is actually /about-us. Update the link in _navigation.html.erb.
The README is missing steps for setting up the database connection. Add clear instructions for PostgreSQL setup.
Requests to /api/ currently 404 even though /api exists. We should normalize paths by stripping trailing slashes.
Several dependencies are outdated. Update to latest stable versions and verify everything still compiles.
The GitHub Actions workflow doesn't test against Ruby 3.2. Add it to the matrix.
The calculator crashes when dividing by zero. Add error handling to return appropriate error message.

issue_title: Add version flag to main command
issue_body: The CLI doesn't have a --version flag. Implement it to display the current version from VERSION file.
The API cannot be called from browsers due to CORS policy. Add the actix-cors middleware with permissive settings for development.
We need a contributing guide to help new contributors understand our workflow and coding standards.
It's hard to debug without seeing the request params. Add logging of params when in development environment.

issue_title: Fix memory leak in Texture class
issue_body: The Texture class doesn't delete OpenGL resources in destructor causing memory leak. Add proper cleanup.
Users want to see what SQL would be executed before running migrations. Add a --dry-run flag.
The project uses old tokio 0.2. Update to latest tokio and fix any breaking changes.
The README doesn't show how to apply and configure the plugin. Add a simple example block.
Currently returns 404 for all unknown routes. We should return 405 for routes with wrong HTTP methods.
The CLI would be more user-friendly with shell completions. Add support for generating completions with clap.
The application lacks a health check for Kubernetes. Implement a simple /q/health endpoint.
Tasks can run indefinitely. Add a timeout option to prevent hanging threads.
Currently config values cannot be overridden by env vars. Add viper's automatic env binding.
Our custom date type doesn't implement Serialize. Add serde support using timestamp representation.
Debugging is hard without seeing HTTP traffic. Add a filter to log requests and responses.

issue_title: Add retry limit to email worker
issue_body: The email worker retries indefinitely on failure. Add a max retry count of 3.
The binary search implementation returns wrong index for elements at the end of array.
We need to track requests across logs. Add middleware that injects a unique request ID.
The image filter runs sequentially. Use rayon to parallelize the pixel processing.

issue_title: Add indexes to frequently queried columns
issue_body: The users table queries by email are slow. Add database index on email column.
Sometimes the same job gets enqueued multiple times. Add a uniqueness constraint based on arguments.

issue_title: Optimize memory usage in merge sort
issue_body: The merge sort implementation creates temporary vectors for each merge. Reuse a single buffer.
The data grid doesn't show when data is loading. Add a loading spinner.
The API doesn't support versioning. Add /v1/ prefix to all routes.
We need a producer-consumer queue. Implement a thread-safe queue using mutex and condition variable.

issue_title: Convert tests to use testify suite
issue_body: Current tests use raw if statements. Refactor to use testify's suite package for better organization.
The CalculatorTests are repetitive. Use @ParameterizedTest to test multiple inputs.
The app lacks security headers. Add CSP header with basic directives.
Log file grows indefinitely. Implement log rotation based on file size.
We need better tracing. Add a span that covers the entire request lifecycle.
We don't know which endpoints are slow. Add metrics to track request duration.
The API crashes on malformed JSON. Add error handling to return 400.
The client creates new connection for each request. Implement simple connection reuse.
The server doesn't handle SIGTERM. Add signal handling to shut down gracefully.

issue_title: Add retry logic for transient failures
issue_body: Network issues cause failures. Add retry with exponential backoff for failed requests.
The posts table has user_id but no foreign key. Add the constraint with cascade delete.

issue_title: Add test case for edge values
issue_body: The math functions aren't tested with max/min int values. Add test cases for boundaries.

issue_title: Replace unwrap with proper error handling
issue_body: The code uses unwrap everywhere. Replace with proper error propagation using ? and thiserror.

issue_title: Add builder pattern to User class
issue_body: The User class has many fields. Add @Builder annotation to simplify object creation.
The login feature has no integration tests. Add Capybara test for happy path.
We have ltrim and rtrim but no trim. Implement trim that removes spaces from both ends.
Currently templates are read from disk. Use go:embed to bundle them in binary.

issue_title: Handle null fields in JSON serialization
issue_body: Null fields are currently omitted. Configure Jackson to include them with null values.
Several models have similar specs. Extract shared examples to reduce duplication.
The Makefile only builds. Add make install to copy binary to /usr/local/bin.
The parser doesn't handle YAML multiline strings with | or >. Add support.
The service layer has no tests. Use Mockito to mock repository and test business logic.
The string comparison for passwords is vulnerable to timing attacks. Implement constant-time compare.
User input can have different Unicode forms. Normalize to NFC before processing.
Some database operations don't close connections properly. Refactor to use try-with-resources.
The app doesn't log requests. Create a simple middleware to log method and path.
Multiple threads increment without synchronization. Add atomic operation or mutex.
Items stay in cache forever. Add time-to-live with background cleanup goroutine.
The tool only searches current directory. Add -r flag to search recursively.
Requests with UTF-8 characters are garbled. Add filter to set request/response encoding.
The pool doesn't wait for tasks to finish on shutdown. Implement graceful termination.

issue_title: Set C++ standard to C++17 in CMakeLists
issue_body: The project doesn't specify C++ standard. Add set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17).
Connections drop without activity. Implement ping/pong to keep alive.
New users struggle with migrations. Add example showing how to run migrations.
Passwords are stored in plain text. Configure BCryptPasswordEncoder.
We need to clean old records daily. Add a scheduled job that runs every night.

issue_title: Convert raw pointers to smart pointers
issue_body: The code uses new/delete. Refactor to use unique_ptr and shared_ptr.
We can't easily call methods from CLI. Enable gRPC server reflection.
The WASM module panics on missing DOM element. Check existence before accessing.
Currently sends plain text only. Add method to send HTML emails with attachments.

issue_title: Add JSON schema validation for config
issue_body: The config file format isn't validated. Use JSON Schema to validate on load.

issue_title: Implement reverse iterator for custom container
issue_body: The custom vector doesn't support rbegin/rend. Add reverse iterator support.
The CLI tool can't show its version. Add flag to display version from build info.

issue_title: Allow setting log level via env var
issue_body: Log level is hardcoded. Use env_logger to read from RUST_LOG environment variable.
The repository queries are hardcoded. Implement JPA Specifications for dynamic queries.
Some classes aren't autoloaded in production. Ensure all directories are in the loader.
The factorial function runs at runtime. Make it constexpr for compile-time evaluation.
We need a reusable filter for slices. Implement a generic function that works with any type.
Parse errors are cryptic. Add nom's context combinator for better messages.

issue_title: Replace loop with stream in report generation
issue_body: The report code uses for loops. Refactor to use Java streams for readability.

issue_title: Update required Ruby version in gemspec
issue_body: The gemspec still requires 2.5 which is EOL. Update to 2.7+.

issue_title: Add concept constraints for numeric types
issue_body: The template accepts any type. Use C++20 concepts to constrain to arithmetic types.
We can't profile the app. Add net/http/pprof to expose profiling data.
We don't know which sort is faster. Add Criterion benchmarks for different algorithms.
The project uses deprecated annotations. Update to modern SpotBugs equivalents.
Debug messages use puts. Replace with proper logger that respects log level.
The app is vulnerable to CSRF. Add middleware with token generation.
Current shared state uses locks. Consider channels for better concurrency.
The code doesn't check if value is null before using. Use Optional to handle nulls.
User input isn't escaped causing XSS risk. Use ERB::Util.html_escape.

issue_title: Add move constructor to String class
issue_body: The custom String class copies even when it could move. Implement move constructor.

issue_title: Update protoc version in generate script
issue_body: The script uses old protoc. Update to latest and adjust import paths.
Currently parsing query params manually. Create a custom extractor for page/limit.
Tests use JUnit assertions. Refactor to AssertJ for better readability and failure messages.
The enum pollutes global namespace. Change to enum class for better scoping.
The counter uses mutex but only increments. Use atomic.AddInt64 for better performance.
The examples only show JSON. Add example using bincode for binary format.
JPA needs default constructor. Add annotation where missing.

issue_title: Add tests for file upload endpoint
issue_body: The file upload feature isn't tested. Add Rack::Test with multipart form data.

issue_title: Add stream output operator for Point class
issue_body: Can't easily print Point objects. Overload operator<< for debugging.
The db functions don't respect cancellation. Add context parameter to all db methods.
The code has many clippy warnings. Fix the pedantic warnings in the codebase.

issue_title: Add toString implementation for Status enum
issue_body: The enum returns uppercase name. Add toString to return formatted status.
The routes.rb file is messy. Use draw to split into multiple files.

issue_title: Simplify sum function with fold expression
issue_body: The variadic template sum is verbose. Use C++17 fold expression.

issue_title: Fix queryset annotation ordering with window functions on MySQL
issue_body: Annotating a Django queryset with Window functions works on Postgres but produces incorrect ORDER BY on MySQL 8. The generated SQL misses the PARTITION BY clause in some edge cases with multiple annotations. A test case with 500k rows is attached showing the discrepancy.

issue_title: Support partial prerendering for dynamic route segments
issue_body: Our marketing site uses Next.js App Router but partial prerendering doesn't work correctly when combined with generateStaticParams for i18n routes. The fallback renders full dynamic content instead of static shell. Documented behavior differs from the Canary implementation.

issue_title: Expose runtime.GOMAXPROCS change callback for custom schedulers
issue_body: We're building a custom task scheduler on top of Go and need to react to GOMAXPROCS changes from the runtime. Currently there's no hook after SetMaxProcs. This would allow rebalancing our worker pools without polling.

issue_title: Support signal-based forms with async validators
issue_body: The new signals API in Angular 17+ doesn't integrate cleanly with async validators in reactive forms. The status changes don't propagate correctly to the signal. A dedicated signalFormGroup would solve validation UX in our enterprise forms.

issue_title: Add built-in support for WebAssembly SIMD in Deno runtime
issue_body: Our ML inference service uses WASM but Deno doesn't expose SIMD instructions yet. The current wasm32 target misses performance gains. Enabling the feature flag by default for deno task would help edge compute use cases.

issue_title: Implement data routers with optimistic UI for nested routes
issue_body: Data routers in React Router v6.4+ don't support optimistic updates for nested layouts. Our dashboard has deeply nested routes where stale data flashes during mutations. Adding useOptimistic hook would clean this up.

issue_title: Generate type-safe Prisma Client for dynamic model names at runtime
issue_body: In our admin panel we need to query models by string name but the generated client only supports static imports. A Prisma.DynamicClient helper would enable meta-programming without losing types.

issue_title: Improve error messages for infer constraints in conditional types
issue_body: The current TS error for failed infer constraints is generic and doesn't show the actual mismatched type. Our library users spend hours debugging. Including the actual type in the message would improve DX.

issue_title: Support for @Formula with window functions in entity mappings
issue_body: Our analytics entities use @Formula with RANK() OVER but Hibernate doesn't translate it correctly for MySQL. The generated SQL misses parentheses. Extending Dialect would solve reporting queries.

issue_title: Implement interceptors for GraphQL subscription events
issue_body: The current NestJS GraphQL module lacks interceptors for subscription payloads. Our real-time features need auth checks on every event. Adding @UseInterceptors on @Subscription would complete the feature parity with queries.

issue_title: Add async support for before_request hooks with context vars
issue_body: Our Flask 2.3+ app uses async views but before_request hooks run sync causing blocking. ContextVars don't propagate correctly. Official async hook support would fix this.

issue_title: Expose net/http Server graceful shutdown timeout per listener
issue_body: Our Go service has multiple listeners but graceful shutdown uses a global timeout. Per-listener config would allow staggered shutdowns for blue-green deploys.

issue_title: Support SmallRye Health UI with custom check groups
issue_body: The Quarkus health UI doesn't allow filtering checks by group tags. Our microservices have 50+ checks and the UI becomes unusable. Adding group support would improve ops dashboards.

issue_title: Implement rolling quantile with interpolation options for time-series
issue_body: The current rolling.quantile doesn't expose the interpolation param like scipy. Our financial models need 'midpoint' for accurate VaR calculation. This small addition would help.

issue_title: Add built-in OpenTelemetry tracing middleware with baggage
issue_body: The current Gin middleware for tracing doesn't propagate baggage context. Our distributed services lose correlation IDs. Official support would reduce custom code.
Our Spring Boot modules use @ConfigurationProperties but conditional loading based on another bean isn't straightforward. Adding a dedicated annotation would simplify modular apps.

issue_title: Improve error boundaries with async component support in React 19
issue_body: Error boundaries don't catch errors in async components properly during initial render. Our suspense-heavy app shows unhandled promises. Updating the boundary logic would help.

issue_title: Add kubectl top with custom resource metrics from Prometheus
issue_body: The current kubectl top only uses core metrics server but our clusters expose custom Prometheus metrics. Extending the command would help ops teams.

issue_title: Add WebSocket dependency injection for connection state
issue_body: WebSocket endpoints don't support Depends for per-connection state cleanly. Our chat app duplicates logic. A WebSocketDepends class would standardize it.

issue_title: Support generics in net/http HandlerFunc for typed responses
issue_body: The current HandlerFunc doesn't support generics for response types. Our internal framework duplicates code. Adding a generic wrapper would improve type safety.

issue_title: Integrate SmallRye GraphQL with Panache reactive entities
issue_body: GraphQL queries don't automatically map to Panache reactive repositories. Our API layer needs manual mapping. Native integration would simplify.

issue_title: Enhance read_sql with support for async SQLAlchemy engines
issue_body: The current read_sql blocks on async engines. Our data pipeline uses async but falls back to sync. Native async support would prevent thread pool exhaustion.

issue_title: Add useDeferredValue with priority hints for concurrent rendering
issue_body: The useDeferredValue doesn't accept priority hints like useTransition. Our heavy charts lag during navigation. Extending the API would improve UX.

issue_title: Expose Deno.permissions.request for runtime permission prompts
issue_body: Our CLI tools need dynamic permission requests but the API is static. Adding request method would align with browser permissions.

issue_title: Improve kubectl explain with versioned examples
issue_body: The explain command shows generic examples but not version-specific for CRDs. Our operators need better docs integration.

issue_title: Support ISR with custom cache handlers for edge runtimes
issue_body: Incremental Static Regeneration doesn't allow custom cache backends on edge. Our global CDN setup needs this.

issue_title: Implement np.unique with return_inverse for object dtype
issue_body: The current unique doesn't support return_inverse for non-numeric. Our NLP preprocessing needs it for token vocab.

issue_title: Add strictNullChecks enforcement for template literal unions
issue_body: Template literal unions don't respect strictNullChecks in some inference paths. This causes runtime surprises in our string-typed configs.

issue_title: Add sync.Cond with context cancellation support
issue_body: The current Cond doesn't integrate with context for wait cancellation. Our worker pools have to use extra channels.

issue_title: Add support for Prisma Studio theming and custom branding
issue_body: Prisma Studio is great but lacks theming for enterprise branding. Our internal tools need dark mode consistency.

issue_title: Optimize Styler for large DataFrames with conditional formatting
issue_body: The Styler slows down dramatically above 10k rows with custom formatters. Our reporting needs faster HTML export.

issue_title: Implement useId with stable IDs across server/client for portals
issue_body: The useId generates different IDs on server vs client for portals causing hydration mismatches. Our modals break.

issue_title: Add Deno.test with built-in snapshot testing for objects
issue_body: The current testing lacks deep object snapshots like Jest. Our component library tests are verbose.

issue_title: Extend kubectl get with custom column sorting for CRDs
issue_body: The get command sorting doesn't work for stringified JSON columns in CRDs. Our monitoring needs better CLI views.

issue_title: Provide lifespan context manager for background scheduler integration
issue_body: Integrating APScheduler requires manual lifespan handling. A built-in scheduler context would simplify cron jobs.

issue_title: Add route segment config for experimental PPR in layout files
issue_body: Partial Prerendering config is only at page level but our layouts need per-segment control. This limits adoption.

issue_title: Add support for np.fft with real-valued input optimizations
issue_body: The FFT functions don't auto-detect real input for faster rfft path. Our signal processing pipeline misses speedups.

issue_title: Improve union type narrowing with literal template keys
issue_body: Literal template types in unions don't narrow correctly in switch statements. Our router code has many type guards.

issue_title: Support io/fs with embedded FS for http.FileServer caching
issue_body: The embedded FS doesn't provide ETag headers automatically. Our static asset serving needs better caching.

issue_title: Integrate OIDC with Keycloak admin client for dynamic client registration
issue_body: The OIDC extension doesn't expose admin client for runtime registration. Our SaaS onboarding needs this.

issue_title: Support for extended client with batch transaction limits
issue_body: The extended client doesn't respect max batch size for transactions. Our bulk operations hit limits unexpectedly.

issue_title: Implement DataFrame.ewm with custom alpha decay functions
issue_body: The ewm only supports fixed com/span but our forecasting needs custom decay. Adding callable alpha would help.

issue_title: Add forwardRef support for server components with useImperativeHandle
issue_body: Server components can't forward refs properly with imperative handles. Our canvas library breaks.

issue_title: Expose Deno.version for runtime compatibility checks in scripts
issue_body: Scripts can't easily check Deno version without parsing user agent. A global Deno.version would simplify polyfills.

issue_title: Support for natural id caching with soft locks
issue_body: The natural ID cache doesn't handle concurrent updates with soft locks. Our high-contention entities have stale reads.

issue_title: Add dependency caching for repeated calls within request scope
issue_body: Dependencies recompute even when cached=True in some nested cases. Our auth layer duplicates DB calls.

issue_title: Support dynamic imports with SSR false in app router layouts
issue_body: The dynamic import SSR:false doesn't work in root layouts for third-party widgets. Our analytics break.

issue_title: Add np.histogram2d with density normalization option
issue_body: The histogram2d lacks density param like histogram1d. Our scientific plots need normalized output.

issue_title: Fix excess property checking for discriminated unions with index signatures
issue_body: Excess properties slip through in discriminated unions with index signatures. Our form validators have false positives.

issue_title: Implement context.WithTimeoutCause for better error wrapping
issue_body: The current WithTimeout doesn't attach cause properly for debugging. Our timeout handling is verbose.

issue_title: Support RESTEasy Reactive with SSE and backpressure
issue_body: The SSE implementation doesn't respect backpressure from subscribers. Our event streams overload clients.

issue_title: Add middleware for query logging with custom formatters
issue_body: The current logging is fixed format but our ELK stack needs structured JSON. Custom middleware would help.

issue_title: Support read_parquet with partitioned datasets and hive schema inference
issue_body: The read_parquet ignores hive partitioning metadata in some cases. Our data lake queries fail.

issue_title: Implement useActionState with server actions and optimistic updates
issue_body: The new useActionState doesn't integrate optimistic updates natively. Our forms show stale state during submission.

issue_title: Add Deno.makeTempDir with custom prefix/suffix options
issue_body: The temp dir API is basic and doesn't support prefixes like os.tmpdir. Our test runners need better isolation.

issue_title: Extend kubectl logs with tail and since-time for multiple containers
issue_body: The logs command requires separate calls for multi-container pods. A combined flag would simplify debugging.

issue_title: Support @Cacheable with region per entity subclass
issue_body: The second level cache doesn't allow per-subclass regions easily. Our polymorphic entities have cache thrashing.

issue_title: Provide automatic 422 validation error customization per endpoint
issue_body: The global 422 handler can't be overridden per route easily. Our API needs custom messages.

issue_title: Support static generation with fetch cache: 'force-cache' in middleware
issue_body: Middleware fetch calls ignore cache config for static exports. Our auth checks are always dynamic.

issue_title: Implement np.corrcoef with rowvar=False default for pandas compatibility
issue_body: The corrcoef default rowvar confuses pandas users migrating code. A pandas-friendly alias would help.

issue_title: Deadlock in async runtime when combining select! with nested spawns
issue_body: The select! macro exhibits a deadlock condition when a nested spawn inside one of its branches attempts to acquire a mutex held by the outer task. This reproduces consistently under high concurrency with more than 16 worker threads. The root cause appears to be in the task-stealing scheduler failing to yield correctly when a waker is dropped mid-poll. We have traced it to the park_timeout path in runtime/src/park.rs. A minimal reproducer is attached showing the issue with a 2-branch select! and a shared Arc<Mutex<T>>. This blocks our production migration to async-first architecture.

issue_title: net/http: Connection pool exhaustion under sustained load with HTTP/2 multiplexing
issue_body: Under sustained load with HTTP/2 enabled the connection pool silently exhausts without returning errors to callers. The Transport.MaxConnsPerHost setting is respected initially but after approximately 10k requests the pool starts leaking connections that are never returned. Profiling with pprof shows goroutines stuck in persistConn.writeRequest indefinitely. We believe the issue is related to RST_STREAM frames not being processed when the write buffer is full. This is a regression introduced in Go 1.22.3 based on our bisect results.

issue_title: Conditional type inference breaks with recursive mapped types in strict mode
issue_body: When using a recursive mapped type combined with a conditional type that has an infer clause TypeScript 5.4 produces incorrect narrowing in strict mode. The inferred type is widened to unknown instead of correctly resolving the recursive branch. This worked correctly in TypeScript 5.2. The regression appears to be related to the changes in variance inference introduced in the 5.3 cycle. A repro is available on the TypeScript Playground demonstrating the incorrect never propagation through three levels of recursion.

issue_title: Consumer group rebalance storm triggered by transient ZooKeeper session expiry
issue_body: A transient ZooKeeper session expiry of under 200ms is causing a full consumer group rebalance storm affecting all 48 consumers in our cluster. The rebalance loop does not terminate and consumers are unable to make progress. Analysis of the broker logs shows the group coordinator is not correctly distinguishing between a session expiry and a clean leave. We have patched GroupCoordinator.scala locally to add a grace period but this needs to be addressed upstream. This issue has caused multiple SLA breaches in our production environment.

issue_title: Timing side-channel in RSA-OAEP decryption path under constant-time bypass
issue_body: Our security team identified a timing side-channel in the RSA-OAEP decryption code path that can be triggered when the hardware acceleration fallback is activated. The RSA_padding_check_PKCS1_OAEP_mgf1 function does not maintain constant-time behavior when the MGF1 hash mismatch occurs in the accelerated path. This was discovered using a Manger-style timing oracle attack in a lab environment with 10^6 decryption queries. We are responsibly disclosing this after coordinating with the security team per the published process.

issue_title: CUDA kernel launch race in custom autograd Function with non-default streams
issue_body: A race condition occurs in custom autograd Functions when the forward pass launches CUDA kernels on a non-default stream and the backward pass is scheduled before stream synchronization completes. The gradient computation produces non-deterministic NaN values approximately 1 in 50 runs. This is not reproducible with the default CUDA stream. The issue lies in engine.cpp where saved tensors are accessed without checking the originating stream completion status. We have a reproducer using torch.autograd.Function with explicit stream management.

issue_title: State lock deadlock when concurrent applies target overlapping resources
issue_body: Running two concurrent terraform apply operations that target overlapping but non-identical resource sets causes a state lock deadlock in the remote backend. The lock acquisition follows different ordering depending on the dependency graph traversal which is non-deterministic. The backend correctly returns a lock error for the second apply but the first apply then hangs indefinitely waiting for a lock it already holds. This has been reproduced with both S3 and Terraform Cloud backends. The fix likely requires lock ordering to be canonicalized before acquisition.

issue_title: kubelet memory leak when watching large numbers of ConfigMaps with field selectors
issue_body: The kubelet process exhibits a slow memory leak when configured to watch more than 500 ConfigMaps using field selectors. The leak rate is approximately 50MB per hour under steady state. Heap profiling with go tool pprof shows the accumulation is in the reflector cache which is not correctly evicting entries when field-selector-filtered watches receive MODIFIED events. This was introduced in the 1.29 release cycle based on our bisect. We are running 1.30.1 and have confirmed the issue does not occur on 1.28.

issue_title: ICE: internal compiler error with const generics and where clause on associated type
issue_body: The Rust compiler panics with an internal compiler error when a const generic parameter is used in a where clause constraining an associated type of a trait bound. The panic message is assertion failed in rustc_trait_selection. This reproduces on stable 1.77 and nightly. The workaround is to remove the const generic and use a runtime value but this defeats the purpose of the abstraction. A minimal reproducer of 15 lines is attached.

issue_title: QuerySet.annotate() with Window function produces incorrect SQL for multi-database routers
issue_body: Using QuerySet.annotate() with a Window function expression on a project with multiple database routers generates incorrect SQL that references the wrong schema prefix. The generated query uses the default database alias even when the queryset has been explicitly routed to a secondary database. This causes either a table-not-found error or silently reads from the wrong database. The issue is in django/db/models/sql/compiler.py in the as_sql method for window expressions. Affects Django 4.2 and 5.0.

issue_title: Incorrect loop vectorization with pointer aliasing assumptions in O3
issue_body: The LLVM loop vectorizer generates incorrect code at O3 when two pointers that are provably non-aliasing per restrict annotations are involved in a loop with a conditional store. The vectorized output produces wrong results on ARM SVE targets but correct results on x86. This is a miscompilation bug. We have verified the issue using a differential fuzzing harness comparing scalar and vectorized outputs across 10^7 random inputs. The bug is in lib/Transforms/Vectorize/LoopVectorize.cpp in the alias analysis integration.

issue_title: Streaming RPC metadata lost after server-side load balancer reconnect
issue_body: When a server-side load balancer triggers a reconnect during an active bidirectional streaming RPC the per-call metadata attached to the stream is silently dropped after the reconnect. Subsequent messages on the stream proceed without the original metadata causing authorization failures downstream. The metadata loss was confirmed by comparing interceptor logs before and after the reconnect event. This is a regression from v1.62 based on our changelog review. The fix likely requires metadata to be reattached from the stream context during transport recreation.

issue_title: Concurrent mode tearing with useMutableSource and external store mutations
issue_body: React 18 concurrent mode exhibits observable tearing when useMutableSource is used with an external store that mutates synchronously during a high-priority render interruption. The component tree renders with inconsistent snapshots of the store across siblings. This violates the consistency guarantee described in the RFC. We have a reproducible test using Zustand with synchronous state mutations and high-frequency useTransition updates that shows different values in sibling components reading the same store slice.

issue_title: TSM engine compaction stalls under write-heavy workload with large tag cardinality
issue_body: The TSM storage engine stalls compaction when the tag cardinality exceeds 10^6 unique series under a sustained write load of 500k points per second. The compaction goroutine blocks on index merging for periods up to 45 seconds causing write backpressure to propagate to ingestion. This eventually causes the WAL to fill and writes to be rejected. The issue is in the tsi1 index compaction path where the bloom filter rebuild is O(n^2) in cardinality. We have a patch that replaces this with a streaming merge but need upstream review.

issue_title: Circuit breaker not triggered for aggregation memory on coordinating node
issue_body: The field data circuit breaker fails to account for aggregation working memory allocated on the coordinating node during a terms aggregation with a very large bucket count. This allows the JVM heap to fill completely before the breaker trips causing OOM kills in production. The root cause is that InternalAggregations.reduce() allocates intermediate collections outside of the circuit breaker accounting framework. We have reproduced this consistently on a 3-node cluster with 16GB heap per node using a cardinality of 5M terms.

issue_title: Cypher query planner selects inefficient index strategy for composite node properties
issue_body: The Cypher query planner consistently selects a full node scan instead of the available composite index when a query combines an equality predicate on a composite property with a range predicate on a second property. EXPLAIN output confirms the index is not being considered. This results in 100x slower query execution on our 50M node graph. We have verified the composite index exists and is ONLINE. The issue does not occur when the properties are queried individually. This appears to be a planner regression introduced in Neo4j 5.18.

issue_title: WAIT command returns incorrect replica count under partial replication state
issue_body: The WAIT command returns a replica count that is higher than the actual number of replicas that have acknowledged the write when a partial replication sync is in progress. This causes callers relying on WAIT for write durability guarantees to proceed with a false sense of data safety. The incorrect count is caused by replicas in the partial sync state being counted as fully synchronized. We discovered this during a failover drill where data loss occurred despite WAIT 2 0 succeeding. This is a correctness bug with data integrity implications.

issue_title: IPC reader produces incorrect null bitmaps for nested list arrays with offset
issue_body: The Arrow IPC reader produces incorrect null bitmaps when deserializing nested List<List<T>> arrays that have a non-zero offset on the outer list. The null positions are shifted by the offset value causing incorrect null checks downstream. This is a silent data corruption bug with no exception raised. We discovered it during a cross-language data exchange between a Python writer and a C++ reader. The bug is in ipc/reader.cc in the LoadRecordBatch function handling of nested offset buffers.

issue_title: Alert rule evaluation skipped silently when evaluation interval less than scheduler tick
issue_body: Alert rules with an evaluation interval smaller than the Grafana scheduler tick duration are silently skipped without generating a missed evaluation event or log entry. This causes alerts to never fire even when conditions are met. The missed evaluations are not reflected in the alert state history. We discovered this after a production incident where a critical alert with a 50ms interval never fired during a 15-minute outage. The scheduler loop does not account for sub-tick intervals.

issue_title: BPF map pressure causes packet drops under high connection churn
issue_body: Under high connection churn exceeding 50k new connections per second the BPF conntrack map fills to capacity causing new connections to be silently dropped without generating any observable error. The map size is correctly configured at 1M entries but entries are not being evicted fast enough by the garbage collection goroutine. The GC interval is hardcoded to 30 seconds which is too slow for high-churn workloads. We need a configurable eviction policy and a metrics endpoint for map pressure. This is blocking our adoption of Cilium as the primary CNI in production.

issue_title: Workflow history corruption when activity result exceeds payload size limit silently
issue_body: When an activity returns a result that exceeds the configured payload size limit Temporal silently truncates the payload instead of failing the activity with a clear error. The truncated payload is then persisted to the workflow history causing the workflow to operate on corrupted data in subsequent steps. This is a data integrity issue. The correct behavior should be to fail the activity and surface a PayloadSizeExceededError. We traced the truncation to internal/internal_task_handlers.go in the activity result serialization path.

issue_title: VSchema routing rules ignored for scatter queries with INFORMATION_SCHEMA joins
issue_body: VSchema routing rules are completely ignored when a scatter query includes a JOIN with an INFORMATION_SCHEMA table. The query is routed to all shards instead of following the configured routing rules causing unnecessary load and incorrect results in some cases. This was introduced in the Vitess 18 release. We have tested with both hash and lookup vindexes and the behavior is consistent. The issue is in the planner handling of INFORMATION_SCHEMA as a special keyspace that bypasses routing rule evaluation.

issue_title: HTTP filter chain selection incorrect when SNI and ALPN disagree on TLS handshake
issue_body: The HTTP filter chain selection logic incorrectly matches filter chains when the SNI value and ALPN protocol negotiated during the TLS handshake belong to different configured chains. The wrong filter chain is applied causing requests to be processed with incorrect configuration including wrong upstream clusters and incorrect rate limits. This is a security-relevant misconfiguration that can lead to traffic leaking to unintended backends. We have a reproducible test case using curl with explicit SNI and ALPN overrides.

issue_title: mTLS passthrough broken after upgrade to Istio 1.21 with custom AuthorizationPolicy
issue_body: After upgrading from Istio 1.20 to 1.21 mTLS passthrough mode stops working for workloads with a custom AuthorizationPolicy that references a ServiceAccount principal. The connections are rejected with a 403 even though the policy permits the principal. The issue does not occur without the AuthorizationPolicy or with the default STRICT PeerAuthentication. We have traced the regression to changes in the ext_authz filter ordering in the 1.21 release notes. This blocks our upgrade path for all production namespaces.

issue_title: Batch processor memory spike when exporter backpressure causes queue overflow
issue_body: The batch processor exhibits severe memory spikes when the downstream exporter applies backpressure causing the internal queue to overflow. Instead of dropping spans according to the configured sending_queue overflow policy the processor accumulates spans in memory until OOM. The queue_size and num_consumers settings are correctly configured but the backpressure signal from the exporter is not propagating correctly to the batch processor admission control. This results in collector pods being OOM killed under load spike conditions.

issue_title: HNSW index corruption on concurrent writes with class schema modification
issue_body: Concurrent write operations to a Weaviate class combined with a schema property addition result in HNSW index corruption. The corruption manifests as missing objects in vector search results that are confirmed present via the object GET endpoint. The issue is a race condition between the schema change handler and the HNSW graph modification lock. We discovered this during a rolling deployment that updated the schema while ingestion was running. The HNSW graph needs to be rebuilt after the corruption is detected which causes significant downtime.

issue_title: Workflow pod GC fails silently when node is NotReady during pod deletion
issue_body: The Argo Workflows pod garbage collection process fails silently when the Kubernetes node hosting the workflow pod enters a NotReady state during pod deletion. The pod object is removed from the workflow pod list prematurely causing the workflow controller to mark the associated node as succeeded when it may have failed or not completed. This results in incorrect workflow completion states in the audit log. We need the GC process to verify the pod actual terminal state before marking the workflow node complete.

issue_title: Snapshot layer deduplication skipped for OCI images with non-canonical layer ordering
issue_body: The containerd snapshotter skips layer deduplication when an OCI image is pushed with layer descriptors in a non-canonical order that differs from the content-addressable store internal ordering. This causes duplicate layer data to be stored consuming additional disk space proportional to the number of non-canonical layers. In our environment this has caused a 3x increase in snapshot storage usage. The deduplication logic in snapshots/storage/bolt.go assumes canonical ordering which is not guaranteed by the OCI image spec.

issue_title: SVID rotation race condition causes brief authentication failures under high load
issue_body: The SPIRE agent SVID rotation logic has a race condition that causes a brief window where both the old and new SVIDs are invalid from the perspective of the relying party. Under high load with many simultaneous rotations this window can last up to 2 seconds causing authentication failures in workloads that have cached the expiring SVID. The rotation process should follow a prepare-commit pattern where the new SVID is pre-distributed before the old one expires. This is documented as a known issue in the RFC but no fix has been implemented.

issue_title: Message replay ordering violated when JetStream consumer restarts with ack_policy=explicit
issue_body: JetStream consumers configured with ack_policy=explicit and deliver_policy=by_start_sequence produce messages out of delivery order when the consumer restarts during a replay of a large stream. The out-of-order delivery is confirmed by sequence number inspection. The root cause is that the pending message tracking map is not correctly restored from the consumer durable state after restart causing some sequence ranges to be re-delivered before others. This breaks applications relying on ordered processing semantics from JetStream.

issue_title: Optimizer incorrectly estimates row count for partial indexes with overlapping predicates
issue_body: The CockroachDB query optimizer produces incorrect row count estimates for queries that can use multiple partial indexes with overlapping predicates. The optimizer assumes independence between the predicates and multiplies selectivity estimates causing a severe underestimate of the true row count. This leads to suboptimal plan selection favoring nested loop joins over hash joins at large scales. We have a 10M row table where this causes 50x query slowdowns. The fix requires the optimizer selectivity model to account for predicate overlap in partial index candidates.

issue_title: Proxy CPU spike on control plane reconnect due to unbounded retry storm
issue_body: The Linkerd proxy exhibits a CPU spike on data plane pods when the control plane connection is interrupted and subsequently restored. The spike is caused by an unbounded retry storm where all proxies reconnect simultaneously and flood the control plane with destination API requests. The reconnect logic does not implement exponential backoff with jitter. Under our 2000-pod deployment this causes the control plane to become unavailable for 30-60 seconds after each restart. We need a configurable backoff strategy with jitter for the destination API client.
